description: Welcome to our charming 80 m² Haussmann apartment located close to Gare du Nord, in the heart of the 10th arrondissement of Paris! Enjoy the classic elegance of our furnished space, ideal for travelers looking for comfort and practicality.The space🏡 **Apartment features:**- 3 well-appointed bedrooms (2 with queen size beds, 1 with two single beds that can be pushed together)- Living room open to the kitchen, offering a friendly space- 1 modern bathroom and 2 toilets for added convenience- Terrace to enjoy the outdoors- Practical amenities such as washing machine, dryer, iron 🚉 **Exceptional proximity:**Less than a 2-minute walk to Gare du Nord, our privileged location makes it easy to get around the city of lights. Shops, cafes and restaurants are also nearby, for an authentic Parisian experience. 🍽️ **Exclusive benefits for our guests:**- Special discounts at our partner restaurant- Advantageous currency exchange fees with our partner exchange office Book now and experience Parisian authenticity in our Haussmannian apartment, combining modern comfort and classic charm. We can't wait to host you in the City of Lights! ✨Other things to noteConcierge service is available for luggage storage.
